INSERT INTO model_registry (
        model_id,
        display_name,
        series,
        version,
        competitor_target,
        specialization,
        status,
        parameter_scale,
        checkpoint_path,
        updated_at
    ) VALUES (
        'mindarchitect-forge-smoke',
        'Mindarchitect Forge Smoke',
        'Development',
        '5.6',
        'Autonomous Flagship Workload',
        'Registered model weights checkpoint',
        'DEVELOPMENT_ONLY',
        '19.2M',
        '/working_dir/c_b8753ce5d6140fea/mindarchitect/apps/mindarchitect-training/artifacts/forge-smoke/smoke_weights.npz',
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (model_id) DO UPDATE SET
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        checkpoint_path = EXCLUDED.checkpoint_path,
        parameter_scale = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.parameter_scale, model_registry.parameter_scale),
        updated_at = NOW();
